protocol: Independent original holdout; not used for screening or prompt changes; once per qualifying model per target. Source notes never included in prompt.

lines.text: I lent her two keys; she did not lend them to me.
lines.reviewNote: Two keys; I lent to her, not the reverse.

lines.text: If dawn stays dark, leave the bell untouched.
The tide borrowed my shadow, not my voice.
lines.reviewNote: Shadow borrowed; voice explicitly excluded; no extra stanza.

lines.text: 我只归还了三封信，没有拿走第四封。
lines.reviewNote: Returned only three letters; did not take fourth.

lines.text: 别把灯递给我，给她；我会在门外等。
lines.reviewNote: Lamp to her, not me; I wait outside.

lines.text: 月光落进空杯，却没有替我说一句话。
lines.reviewNote: Moonlight enters empty cup; says nothing on my behalf.

lines.text: 君が帰らなくても、私は窓を閉めない。
lines.reviewNote: Even if you do not return, I will not close the window.

lines.text: 四つの石のうち、二つだけを川に戻して。
lines.reviewNote: Of four stones return only two to river.

lines.text: 朝は名前を呼ばずに、橋だけを照らした。
lines.reviewNote: Morning illuminated only bridge; did not call a name.

lines.text: 그녀가 나를 기다린 게 아니라 내가 그녀를 기다렸어.
lines.reviewNote: I waited for her, not she for me.

lines.text: 파란 리본은 여기에 두고 검은 우산만 가져가.
lines.reviewNote: Leave blue ribbon here; take only black umbrella.

lines.text: 바람은 내 편지를 읽지 않고 창문만 흔들었어.
lines.reviewNote: Wind did not read my letter; only shook window.
